subject.title: security(audit): warn on plugin load paths and SecretRef env fallback

question: After routine diagnostics are restored to non-executing behavior, should OpenClaw adopt the proposed plugin load-path and SecretRef fallback check IDs, severities, scope, and remediation?
rationale: Source review can resolve the execution defect, but the resulting warnings define operator trust and credential-remediation policy owned by secops.

options.title: Repair then approve
options.body: Preserve explicit exec-provider opt-in, add entry-point side-effect tests, format the catalog, and approve the warning contract through secops review.

options.title: Split the change
options.body: Land the independently bounded plugin load-path diagnostics and redesign SecretRef fallback detection in a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Repair then approve
recommendation.body: Preserve explicit exec-provider opt-in, add entry-point side-effect tests, format the catalog, and approve the warning contract through secops review.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest concrete history across the affected secrets, Doctor, and security-audit paths among identified individual contributors.
